item.title: Getting Better
item.description: I am self-aware that a lot of my recent newsletters have been a lot of words that honestly don’t say much. They’d fully qualify as navel-gazing. It’s a time in my life for navel-gazing. The orientation is still toward bringing myself toward full participation in liberation, so I hope it’s still fascinating to read, if in a different way than my newsletters used to be. I’ve been getting more subscribers recently, so that’s reassuring. If you’ve been enjoying these letters, consider recommending them.
